**Alexandria**[[a]] is a major city in Egypt. Lying at the western edge of the [Nile River Delta], it extends about 40 km (25 mi) along the [country's northern coast]. It is Egypt's principal [seaport], the [second largest] city after [Cairo], and the [largest city on the Mediterranean coast]. Founded in 331 BC by [Alexander the Great],[[8]] Alexandria was one of the largest and most important cities of [antiquity] and a leading hub for [science], [culture], and [scholarship].

Nicknamed the "Bride of the Mediterranean" and "Pearl of the Mediterranean Coast",[[9]] the city is a popular tourist destination and a major industrial centre. It is the [sixth-largest city] in the [Arab world], [seventh-largest city] in the Middle East, and the [eleventh-largest city] in Africa. The capital of the [Alexandria Governorate], Alexandria is considered an industrial hub and is home to the [Alexandria Shipyard].
